input_boundaries.generalization_rationale: Same pattern class as web 'request object accessors': a constructor that parses external input into a params object, plus attribute reads of that object. execution_apis.evidence: 42 subprocess exec-family call sites under lib/ (module_utils/basic.py:2020 inside run_command, plugins/connection/local.py:97, ssh.py:577/888/1342/1353, winrm.py:364, executor/task_executor.py:1111, galaxy, parsing/vault, plugins/lookup/lines.py:56 and pipe.py:70 with shell=True, utils/cmd_functions.py:44); one from-import style in utils/galaxy.py:24
execution_apis.notes: Argument index 0 carries the command. shell=True keyword and sequence-vs-scalar arg0 recorded in the exec_mode column. os.system/os.popen: only 2 os.system sites, both in hacking/test-module.py (dev harness) - family still emitted; os.popen has 0 occurrences.

execution_apis.evidence: lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py:1842 definition; 295 call sites across modules and module_utils (facts, service, package managers); 35 call sites pass use_unsafe_shell=True (shell=True path via shlex/stringify); string+use_unsafe_shell=False path re-splits with shlex and expands ~ and env vars (basic.py:1937-1941)
execution_apis.notes: Argument index 0 (args) is the command; exec_mode column distinguishes use_unsafe_shell=True vs False/default and sequence vs scalar arg0. This is the dominant CWE-78 sink surface for module-side code.

execution_apis.evidence: ConnectionBase protocol in plugins/connection/__init__.py:135; overrides local.py:64 (local subprocess.Popen, shell= for str cmd), ssh.py:1262 (runs local ssh binary with cmd), paramiko_ssh.py:374; 14 call sites (e.g. plugins/action/__init__.py:1250 self._connection.exec_command(cmd, ...))
execution_apis.notes: Argument index 0 (cmd) is the remote command string; receiver text recorded. Execution is remote by design but cmd construction happens on the controller - injection here still yields CWE-78.

execution_apis.evidence: lib/ansible/plugins/action/__init__.py:1212 definition; 23 call sites (152, 394, 453, 730-754, 852, 1112, ...) including keyword form cmd=cmd at line 152
execution_apis.notes: Argument index 0 (cmd, also passed as cmd= kwarg - recorded in exec_mode); builds become/sudo and shell prefixes then delegates to connection.exec_command.

execution_apis.evidence: lib/ansible/modules/expect.py:202,207 (pexpect.run / pexpect._run with module args); lib/ansible/plugins/connection/winrm.py:335 pexpect.spawn(command, kinit_cmdline)

execution_apis.api: functions whose parameter is passed directly into any exec-family call
execution_apis.evidence: lib/ansible/utils/cmd_functions.py:44 run_cmd(cmdargs) -> subprocess.Popen(cmdargs); plugins/connection/local.py:64 exec_command(cmd) -> subprocess.Popen(cmd); plugins/connection/ssh.py:1155 _run(cmd,...) -> subprocess.Popen(cmd)
execution_apis.notes: Emitted as wrapper_definition rows with the parameter position; direct pass-through only (bounded recall, documented) - indirect flows will be recovered in the taint pass via summaries.

excluded_from_candidates: unit/integration tests: paths matching test/%, %/test/%, %/tests/% are excluded from both queries
lib/ansible/plugins/test/** is excluded by the %/test/% pattern (Jinja2 test plugins, not unit tests; no command-execution surface observed there - accepted loss)
hacking/** is kept (not a test fixture tree; hacking/test-module.py contains os.system on a module path and sys.argv handling - kept as candidates, expected to be FP-filtered later)
os.exec*/os.spawn*/commands.getoutput: 0 occurrences under lib/ - family not emitted
pure logging/display helpers (display.py, callback plugins output) are not extracted as sources or sinks
design_caution: Ansible's command/shell/remote-execution functionality is a designed feature: a source-sink pair here is a candidate for review, not automatically a vulnerability. Both extraction queries therefore preserve call signature, dangerous argument position, execution mode (shell=True / use_unsafe_shell=True / argv vs scalar), receiver text, file and line so the labeling and triage stages can judge intent.

extraction_strategy.avoid_overextraction: No indiscriminate all-function-parameter extraction. Sources are limited to the six boundary families above; sinks are limited to the six exec families plus bounded direct pass-through wrapper definitions.
